summary.text:
# 没于烈焰 / Engulfed in Flames

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/infernals_1_events.txt:330-430`
- DLC：Infernals Species Pack
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

“行星锻造者”把行星地形化为火山星球的脚本过程完成时（infernals.31 每月检查，满足条件后发出 infernals.35）。

When the scripted terraforming of a planet into a Volcanic World by Planet Forgers finishes (infernals.31 monthly check, then infernals.35).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口通知（两个选项“很好”“知道了”）：地表被熔岩吞没，行星变为火山世界；脚本同时添加矿藏、融炉区划并清除地形化标志。

A single notice (options "Excellent" and "Acknowledged"): the surface is engulfed in lava and the planet becomes a Volcanic World; the script also adds deposits and melting districts and clears the terraforming flags.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无。

None.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

有飞升天赋 ap_galactic_hyperthermia 时效果不同。

Different with the ascension perk ap_galactic_hyperthermia.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了触发链 infernals.31 → 35。

The trigger chain infernals.31 -> 35 was checked.
